hypothesis: The Boolean support projection of Wu's RTM exposes proof obligations whose original-hypothesis footprint is strictly smaller than the full system.

audit.theorem: If P and B belong to ideals generated by support sets S_P and S_B, then every exact pseudo-remainder in I(B)^k P = Q B + R belongs to the ideal generated by S_P union S_B.

claim_scope: Support sets are certified upper bounds propagated through replayed exact pseudo-division identities; they are not minimal polynomial RTM rows.
